title: Forces Acting on a Wedge
description: Calculate normal forces introduced by wedges. Large forces can be generated with the aid of wedges, where a small force can be translated into large forces using the wedge angle.

components.content:
# Forces Acting on a Wedge

Large forces can be introduced with the aid of wedges. A small force can be translated into large forces.

The normal forces can be calculated as:

**FN = F / (2 sin(Θ / 2))**

Where:
- **FN** = normal force (N)
- **F** = acting force (N)
- **Θ** = wedge angle (degrees)
